title: Driver fires at fleeing car in chase caught on traffic cameras
summary: Police reported a driver was recorded on traffic cameras firing at a fleeing car around midnight. Casings were found; no injuries were reported. Date inferred from a Thursday arrest reported Friday, September 18.

title: Woman fires shot after pointing gun at people including children
summary: Police reported a woman pointed a gun at people, including three children, and fired a shot outside. No injuries were reported. An arrest was reported.

location: 800 block of South Oak Street, Valdosta
title: Gunfire near officers clearing a party
summary: A VPD release reported gunfire as an officer dispersed a large gathering. Officers checked the area and did not locate anyone struck. Four arrests were reported. No gunshot victim is established by this release.

location: Lakeside Apartments, 1700 block of Northside Drive, Valdosta
title: Vehicle window shot out at apartment complex
summary: Police reported a man allegedly shot out a vehicle window with a stolen gun. No injuries were reported. Separate from the May 31 South Oak Street party report (SF-2026-0531).

title: Repeated gunfire reported at apartment complex
summary: Local reporting attributed to VPD describes approximately forty shots discharged into the air after a dispute. Police reported no injuries or property damage and an arrest. This report does not add people to firearm-injury totals.

location: 1700 block of East Moore Street, Valdosta
title: Intoxicated man fires gun during argument at home
summary: Police reported a 57-year-old man, allegedly intoxicated, threatened a home's occupants during an argument and fired a gun several times at 2:50 p.m. on Sunday, April 5 (date and time confirmed by the police release). No injuries or damage were reported. DUI arrest. Corrected Nov 2, 2026: earlier listed as East Monroe Street with an inferred date.
alsoCovered: Lanier County News 4/09; Valdosta Daily Times 4/08 (https://valdostadailytimes.com/2026/04/08/man-charged-with-drunk-shooting-during-argument/)

title: Man fires pistol from driveway; narcotics and gun arrest
summary: Police reported a man fired a pistol several times from his driveway. A felony narcotics and gun arrest was reported. No injuries were reported.

title: Car shot several times during domestic dispute
summary: Police reported a 16-year-old's friends allegedly shot his stepfather's car several times as he drove away during a domestic dispute. Four people were charged; no injuries were reported.

title: Gunfire investigation leads to two arrests
summary: At 10:35 a.m., officers responded to reported gunfire, recovered shell casings and a firearm, and reported no injuries or property damage located. This is a separate location and time from the January 7 convenience-store shooting.
